body.intent: TestDaemonIdlePollSkipsFold is flaky under load: it runs in parallel and checks the package-global planReadCount/planFoldCount deltas, so other parallel internal/api tests' folds count against it (seen 2026-11-15: 'idle poll folded 7 in-flight change sets' in a full go test -p 2 ./internal/api run; it passes alone). Count per fixture or run it serially.
